arguments.description: Create one cohesive 320 by 180 opaque pixel-art city district for Metabolis. Architecture must be the primary read; organ identity must appear only through integrated infrastructure mechanisms. Preserve the supplied guide's exact subject count, approximate positions, and two-route topology, but transform its simplified icon treatment into a richly built urban environment like a compact municipal utility district. The left subject is one civic pump-station building with roof parapets, stepped facade volumes, service bays, ventilation blocks, exterior pipe racks, maintenance platforms, sidewalk curbs, and deep building shadows. Inside that urban building, keep exactly two equally prominent side-by-side pumping chambers with separate interiors, valve rings, one central piston connector, paired pulse bars, and synchronized mechanical rhythm; they may suggest a heart's paired pumping function but must never form a realistic anatomical heart silhouette. Exactly two and only two constant-width city transport roads connect to two distinct station outlets. Route one leaves the station's left outlet, travels west, bends once toward the top, and exits the top edge. Route two leaves the station's bottom outlet, travels south, bends once toward the right, and exits the right edge. Add curbs, utility nodes, deliberate road-surface clusters, and large repeated outward direction arrows. Every direction arrow must have a clearly visible triangular tip and straight shaft, must point away from the station, and must remain readable in a still grayscale image. No loop, ring road, perimeter road, crossing, third road, extra lane, or decorative path. On the right, build one separate empty urban construction lot: closed structural boundary, scaffolding-like corner pylons, repeated diagonal planning hatch across the empty interior, curb cuts, and small mechanical planning nodes, with no completed building inside. Use an orthographic high top-down city-building-game view, one consistent 16-pixel square grid, integer-pixel positions, crisp clustered masonry and metal details, hard stair-step diagonals, uniform exterior outlines, controlled stepped shading, and deliberate surfaces without random speckle noise. Use only these locked values with these semantic roles: #340106 for deepest pump and critical-state shadow; #BA3A3F for the pump mechanisms and outward transport trunks; #C25453 for pump pulses, route arrows, and outward transport highlights; #48A5CF for planning-information shadow and construction boundary; #7AD1FD for planning hatch and planning nodes; #CDD9E1 for planning-information highlights and corner markers; #29314A for cool murky waste body or deepest return shadow only; #404586 for return direction or developmental-signal body only; #53548C for return or developmental-signal highlights only; #91465F for organic terrain and wall deep shadow; #BE6E87 for organic terrain and wall body; #C98197 for organic terrain and generated-material highlights; #B26C09 for stored-energy shadow only; #E2953A for energy or warning-state body only; #DDAD7E for energy or warning-state highlights only; #73CD9B for stable-system structure or completion shadow only; #B1FFD1 for completed-construction body only; #F4FFF8 for completion-confirmation highlights only; #140F1D for every exterior outline and deepest occlusion seam; #514854 for internal architecture, road curbs, and deep non-semantic surfaces; #817582 for secondary architecture, roof modules, and mid non-semantic surfaces; #E8DCCF for shared architectural highlights and small specular points. Use no visible value outside those 22 values and do not exchange their semantic roles. No text, labels, numbers, signage, interface, HUD, characters, people, faces, extra buildings, extra roads, realistic organ shapes, medical cutaways, blood, wounds, exposed tissue, bones, gore, gradients, anti-aliasing, feathering, blur, glow, transparency, smooth vector curves, dithering, random noise, sprite sheet, alternate view, or additional asset studies.
